issues.description: The code renders text strings describing the visuals (e.g., 'Visual: A messy horizontal bookshelf...') rather than implementing the graphical objects (bookshelf, figures) themselves.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace text placeholders with actual Manim Mobjects (lines for shelf, shapes for books, SVGs or lines for stick figures) to establish the scene.

issues.description: The concept of O(N^2) inefficiency is communicated only through text lists, failing to visualize the 'frantic j arrow' and 'spinning clock' required to intuitively show the bottleneck.
issues.suggestedFix: Animate geometric indicators on a number line: one moving slowly ('i') and another scanning rapidly ('j') to visually demonstrate the quadratic workload.

issues.description: The smooth gliding motion of independent pointers described in the storyboard is replaced by static text, losing the visual contrast to the previous nested loop frame.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the text description of arrows and implement two colored triangles or arrows that move along a horizontal line.

issues.description: The 'Opposite-Directional' pattern is described in text rather than shown. The learner cannot observe the spatial convergence of the pointers, which is the core learning objective.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a visual array structure and animate two indicator objects starting at opposite ends and stepping inward towards the center.

issues.description: The 'Fast & Slow' pointer mechanics are presented as bullet points. Without a visual circular track and moving dots, the concept of one pointer 'lapping' the other is lost.
issues.suggestedFix: Draw a circular path and animate two dots moving at different rates (e.g., 2x vs 1x speed) to visually simulate the tortoise and hare logic.

issues.description: Space complexity is explained via a text list describing the visual intent. This abstraction fails to clearly distinguish 'extra memory' from 'in-place' operations.
issues.suggestedFix: Visually split the screen: show a secondary container filling up on one side (O(N)) and elements swapping within the original container on the other (O(1)).

issues.description: Summary icons (Graph, Recycle symbol, Stop sign) are rendered as text descriptions ('Visual: Icons appearing...'), reducing the visual impact of the review.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace text descriptions with simple geometric shapes or symbols (e.g., a plot axis, a recycling icon, a crossed circle) to act as visual anchors for the summary.
